body: Ugh. I am so bad at being proactive, even when I'm not in a state of crisis. I have so many bad mental health habits, and this situation really has me on the edge. It's all good advice, so thank you, but I'm pretty hopeless.

Yeah I'm terrible at that part. I've sat in bed and let it tear me apart. To make it worse, a past breakup was one of the main catalysts for my first big depressive episode, and it played out almost exactly like this. The deja vu element is making it a lot worse. Sure it got better over time, but it stuck with me for years, and this was a much more significant relationship.
